name: Social Welfare Function (SWF) Benchmark
description: A dynamic simulation benchmark where an LLM allocates tasks to a heterogeneous community, balancing collective efficiency and distributive fairness. It evaluates LLMs' ability to make social welfare decisions under trade-offs between productivity and equality.
reputation: A specialized simulation benchmark with limited adoption outside social-science-oriented LLM evaluation, but useful for studying fairness-efficiency trade-offs.
notes: First leaderboard for social welfare allocation by LLMs; highlights challenges in fairness and efficiency trade-offs.
